LONG NARROW OVAL face, moderately tall smooth open forehead, gently visible narrow cheekbones, softly hollow lower cheeks tapering to a SMALL gently POINTED chin, no round doll face. ORIGINAL dark-brown hair in a compact LOW gathered bun with one short plain wooden pin, simple muted MOSS cloth hair band, NO hood, veil, high pyramid cap, jeweled crown, earrings or necklace. Original muted RUST-BROWN practical long cross-collar robe with dark OLIVE cuff/edge, dusty SLATE inner collar and BEIGE cloth sash, close comfortable sleeves and plain dark shoes. role.evidence: 名册王基为魏武将，历安平太守、荆州刺史。演义条目记监军、军事建议、镇南将军及讨诸葛诞军事活动；史条目记求学、谏宫殿建设及著时要论。依军职与地方治理的明确混合身份分类统帅兼文臣，不用兵种或统武智数值决定。
role.bearing: 有地方政务经历的稳重军职统帅，穿实用军装与轻甲；部署、巡视和营防协调保持军事职责，内政核军需与地方事务，接洽和奏报仍保留在岗军装。文务修养可在单一适合场景看平放文书，但不是全套执笔学士；训练监督准备与装备，战斗稳健督察，不挥击。
role.propExceptions: 史条目记求学与著时要论，允许合适内政或谋议场景使用平放单份记录；不据此统一十一图捧书。

Use case: identity-preserve
人物：王基 / person-27
原创汉末三国策略游戏的半写实手绘人物，参考三国志系列人物像的克制、沉稳和自然比例：细墨线、柔和笔触、低饱和青绿与暖赭、自然布帛和铁铜，面容清晰，柔和均衡光线。表情尽量中性，眉眼放松、嘴唇自然闭合，动作幅度小、手部舒适。每张按用途独立设计头像、立绘、半身和横幅取景；场景差异主要通过坐立、道具、视线与构图体现，不为了区分而夸张表演。完整头饰，无文字、水印、边框和拼图，只有一名主体人物。

身份：Original visual age44, sturdy ordinary mature field commander build, normal adult head/shoulder proportions. MEDIUM-LONG BROAD RECTANGULAR face, moderately broad somewhat FLAT forehead, cheekbone width close to strong jaw width, gently FULL lower cheeks, clear WIDE SQUARE jaw and BROAD SQUARE chin; no inward hexagonal cheek taper. Medium-spaced ordinary horizontal eyes, dense but RELAXED straight brows with no sharp inward frown, STRAIGHT medium-WIDE moderately short nose bridge and fairly BROAD rounded tip, medium-width small CLOSED firm mouth. Thick dark short mustache with mostly horizontal natural ends and a compact SHORT separately shaped dark GOATEE below chin, sparse sideburns/clean cheeks, no long pointed beard. Exact own reference guides broad rectangular face, strong jaw and wide straight nose; remove harsh glare, green plume and ornate armor. Distinct from Wang Wei long hexagonal hollow-cheek/narrow convex nose/small chin, Yan Xing triangle/hook nose and Yuan Shao short trapezoid lower-heavy jaw. ORIGINAL LOW plain dark BRONZE-IRON round military helmet with simple narrow cheek guards, no plume, horns, gems or tower. Plain muted BROWN-BRONZE lamellar cuirass over dark OLIVE fitted sleeves, OFFWHITE inner collar, plain brown leather wrist guards and belt, dark leggings and simple field boots. EXACTLY ONE sword fully SHEATHED at viewer-right hip, firmly attached, never drawn. No cape, scarf, decorated shoulder animals or extra dagger. Small plain cord-tied wooden officer token only where expressly specified; quiet practical commander bearing in governance and deployments. 中长阔矩形脸、颊颌近等宽、阔方下巴、稍短宽直鼻、短髭与短独立颏须；低铜铁盔、褐铜甲、暗橄榄袖。
输入图仅作该人物身份与服饰参考，不锁定原图动作或表情。
固定脸型、年龄、胡须、头饰、体型、主色与标志物，身份参考不锁定皱眉或动作。重新设计自然姿态与取景，只做细微神态差异。禁止怒吼、露齿、大笑、瞪眼、挑眉、鬼脸、抓须扶额、向镜头伸掌、大幅挥击、伸臂指点、扭身、飞扬披风和夸张透视；手臂靠近身体，头肩与五官比例正常。中性与自然优先于表情差异。
画幅：1536×1152，横向半身像，有场景背景。
场景含义：汇报已完成事项，克制满意，嘴唇闭合。简洁汇报部署或战果，允许单份军情记录但不必捧卷。
该人物独立表演（符合人物类型，并优先于通用示例手势）：SEATED near-FRONTAL half-body at camp reception chair, ONE hand rests flat on chair arm, OTHER rests on own knee. Natural oral report with slightly content neutral CLOSED lips, exactly one untouched sheathed hip sword, no held scroll.
